featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience with Dr. Roshan Bonde (ENT) at Jiza Clinic. He is extremely soft-spoken, highly professional, and his clinical judgment is truly outstanding.
I first consulted him 2–3 years ago for a severe fungal infection in my right ear. While many other doctors were quick to suggest surgery, Dr. Bonde took a more thoughtful and patient-focused approach. He treated me with simple yet highly effective methods, and I recovered without needing any surgical intervention.
What truly sets him apart is his genuine care for patients. He is not driven by money like many others; instead, he focuses on providing the most appropriate and ethical treatment. He listens carefully, explains clearly, and ensures that the patient feels comfortable and confident.

I highly recommend Dr. Roshan Bonde to anyone looking for a trustworthy and skilled ENT specialist.

#HighlyRecommended #ENTSpecialist #PatientFirst #EthicalDoctor #BestENT #TrustedCare #ProfessionalExcellence #GratefulPatient

The clinic is super clean with soothing plants around which makes the waiting time pleasant.
Doctor is also punctual even though he has prior commitments. He answers all the doubts so well. His approach is so humble. After the first consultation you are 50% healed. The prescription is upto the mark, doctor explains even how to consume the medicine.
The fees are also nominal. Within the stipulated week, my daughter was 80% healed.  And, the following week, she will be completely healed.
I would recommend Doctor Roshan Bonde to everyone.
